summary: Collapsed duplicated Typst main-file/root detection into a shared lua/neotex/util/typst.lua module used by the ftplugin, the web preview plugin, and tinymist pin sync. Main-file detection is now content-aware (prefers the file that actually #include/#imports the current chapter). Removed the redundant <leader>lw watch command in favor of tinymist's exportPdf=onSave, made the project-wide pin auto-sync across :LspRestart via client:exec_cmd (no deprecated APIs), and made the preview toggle/stop authoritative against typst-preview.nvim's own server registry. All 5 phases complete, 8/8 spec assertions pass, and all three real multi-file projects (BimodalLogic, cslib MPL, Logos/Theory manual) smoke-compile successfully via the new helper.
